blocking.question: Target UI framework selection for migrated forms
blocking.default_recommendation: WinForms for lowest event-model delta from VB6 unless UX redesign is in scope.
blocking.impact_if_wrong: High rework risk in form/event parity and control migration.

blocking.question: ActiveX/OCX replacement strategy by dependency
blocking.default_recommendation: Replace common controls and isolate only high-risk dependencies behind adapters.
blocking.impact_if_wrong: Runtime regressions and release delays from unresolved control behavior.

blocking.question: Database contract strategy during migration
blocking.default_recommendation: Preserve contracts initially and modernize behind a compatibility layer.
blocking.impact_if_wrong: Business rule drift and data-side regressions.

blocking.question: Confirm identity/access model (role model, multi-user assumptions, and credential handling).
blocking.default_recommendation: Define target role model and credential policy before implementation.

blocking.question: Are there existing operational constraints or integration dependencies not listed?
blocking.default_recommendation: Resolve with product/business owner before implementation commitment.

blocking.question: What are target latency, throughput, and availability SLOs?
blocking.default_recommendation: Resolve with product/business owner before implementation commitment.

blocking.question: Ground BDD acceptance criteria in real legacy golden flows before Build planning.
blocking.default_recommendation: Regenerate BDD from validated golden flows, route evidence, and SQL touchpoints before Build starts.
blocking.impact_if_wrong: Acceptance criteria will not validate real legacy behavior, creating parity and release risk.

non_blocking.question: Logging and observability stack for migrated runtime
non_blocking.default_recommendation: OpenTelemetry + structured logs for parity troubleshooting.

top_risks.mitigation: Implement thorough testing and backup strategies.
Conduct security audits and implement patches.

Implement golden-flow harness for parity validation

in_scope: Preserve legacy business behavior and workflows

musts: No critical workflow regression for P0 flows

shoulds: Preserve DB contracts unless explicitly approved to change

items.title: User Authentication
items.outcome: The system must authenticate users using existing credentials.
acceptance_criteria: Users can log in with existing credentials.
Authentication errors are logged for audit purposes.
Sessions are securely managed and time out after inactivity.

items.title: Error Handling
items.outcome: The system must implement comprehensive error handling mechanisms.
acceptance_criteria: All errors are captured and logged with sufficient detail.
Users receive meaningful error messages without exposing sensitive information.
System continues to operate smoothly after error occurrences.

items.title: User Interface Modernization
items.outcome: The user interface must be updated to a modern design while preserving functionality.
acceptance_criteria: UI updates do not disrupt existing workflows.
All legacy UI functionalities are preserved.
UI performance meets defined usability benchmarks.

items.title: API Integration
items.outcome: The system must integrate with external APIs while maintaining existing data contracts.
acceptance_criteria: API integrations do not alter existing data contracts.
All API calls are logged for audit purposes.

items.title: Data Security
items.outcome: The system must ensure data security and compliance with internal standards.
acceptance_criteria: Access controls are implemented and enforced.

items.title: Define identity and access model for modernization scope
items.outcome: Confirm role model, credential policy, and multi-user assumptions before implementation.
acceptance_criteria: Remediation implemented and validated against affected legacy flow.
